openFindings.finding: Three enabled livemode webhook endpoints exist. The Supabase endpoint is provider-managed and clearly attributable; the intended current ownership/necessity of financekey.app and finance-renewed.onrender.com is not established by the available CAPITAL-AI evidence.
openFindings.recommendedAction: Confirm endpoint ownership and canonical webhook architecture before disabling, deleting or changing either unresolved endpoint. Reconcile the Stripe endpoint inventory with the owner-confirmed production-host inventory.

openFindings.finding: DPA/DTA and current provider-list evidence establish contractual mechanisms and potential onward recipients, but a CAPITAL-AI-specific assessment of actual onward transfers and supplementary-measure/TIA necessity remains incomplete.

closedOrSupersededFindings.finding: The earlier wildcard subscription finding was tied to endpoint we_1TkXz5PKr4joNbEcCgfa1PBb, which is no longer present. The current Supabase endpoint we_1Tis8RPKr4joNbEc4vuhefcZ is application-managed and uses an explicit event set.
The earlier two-endpoint topology is no longer current. It is replaced by the ownership/lifecycle finding STRIPE-WEBHOOK-OWNERSHIP-002.

limitations: No production Stripe, Render or Supabase configuration was changed during this evidence reconciliation.
An enabled livemode Stripe endpoint proves current account configuration, not that the receiver is healthy, owned by CAPITAL-AI or still business-required.
The global Stripe subprocessor list identifies potential recipients but does not expose per-customer infrastructure routing.
A successful Stripe Link transaction proves use of that payment method for at least one observed transaction, not its continued availability in the current checkout configuration.

The Supabase managed webhook's exact receiver implementation was not reclassified from repository assumptions; this reconciliation relies on current Stripe application metadata plus active Supabase Edge Function inventory for ownership scope.
This flow mapping does not claim GDPR compliance or a completed TIA.
